name: breakhis-virchow2-v1-kernel

normalization.centering: equal support-case raw mean per view
normalization.zero_policy: divide by max(norm, epsilon); exact zero stays zero

support_weights: per head class, each case has equal mass and each of its same-view fields receives1/(n_cases_class*n_fields_case_view)
head_priors: uniform within each head; direct-five1/5 versus dual binary1/2 and conditional malignant1/4
validation_policy: all46 fitting cases as support, validation and excluded cases contribute neither support nor centering
aggregation: compose field joint probabilities then arithmetic means within magnification and across available magnifications
support_instances_scope: three full-fit support heads per role, shared across temperatures; additional46 leave-one-case-out support evaluations per role are fitting diagnostics
selection: earliest maximum end-to-end five-category mean15-subset macroF1 within four shared temperatures
interpretation: frozen approved pathology reader package with its registered transform and official readout; unchanged case-centered cosine KDE and same four temperatures/providerroles; primary C, secondary F, context P; all three encoders reported with12 family settings per arm/role; reused exploratory validation, no95 guarantee
status: registered numerical recipe; actual feature SHA bindings pending accepted full extraction
